useCases.heading: Use Cases
useCases.subheading: The repetitive work we take off your plate — and what your business looks like once it's gone.

items.title: Client & Lead Management
items.headline: Never let a lead go cold
items.problem: Leads arrive faster than your team can log them. Contacts get copied between tools by hand, follow-ups depend on someone remembering, and the deals you lose are the ones nobody got back to in time.
items.solution: Every lead is captured, enriched, and routed the moment it lands — then nudged with the right follow-up until it closes. Your team stops doing data entry and starts working the deals that are ready.

workflows.name: Web Form to CRM Pipeline
workflows.description: Form submissions are enriched, deduplicated, and dropped into your CRM with the right owner and stage.

workflows.name: Automated Follow-Up Sequences
workflows.description: Email and SMS sequences trigger on lead behavior — opened, clicked, ignored — keeping prospects warm on their own.

workflows.name: Client Onboarding Workflow
workflows.description: The moment a deal closes: welcome emails go out, documents get collected, and onboarding tasks land on your team.

workflows.name: Appointment Scheduling & Reminders
workflows.description: Prospects book straight from your calendar. Confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups send themselves.

items.title: Billing & Financial Ops
items.headline: Get paid faster, chase less
items.problem: Invoices wait on someone to remember to send them. Payments get reconciled by hand. Expenses pile up unmatched, and your real financial picture is always a few days — or a few spreadsheets — behind.
items.solution: Invoices fire the moment work is done, payments reconcile themselves, and every expense lands against the right job. Your books stay current without anyone touching a spreadsheet.

workflows.name: Auto-Invoice on Milestone
workflows.description: Hit a billing milestone and an invoice is generated in QuickBooks or Stripe and sent to the client.

workflows.name: Payment Received Notifications
workflows.description: A payment lands, your team gets pinged in Slack, the CRM updates, and the project advances.

workflows.name: Expense-to-Job Matching
workflows.description: Receipts are parsed with AI, matched to the right client or project, and synced to your books.

items.title: Documents & Data Collection
items.headline: Stop chasing paperwork
items.problem: You're emailing clients for the same documents twice, sorting attachments by hand, and re-typing form answers into your systems. Files end up lost in inboxes or saved where no one can find them.
items.solution: Documents get requested, collected, read, and filed automatically — with AI pulling the key data out so nobody re-types anything. Hours of manual sorting just disappear.

workflows.name: Document Request & Collection
workflows.description: Clients are emailed for documents with automatic reminders; what comes back is named and filed for you.

workflows.name: AI-Powered Form Processing
workflows.description: Intake responses are parsed by AI, categorized, and routed to the right workflow or person.

workflows.name: Email Attachment Sorting
workflows.description: Incoming attachments are extracted, classified, and filed in Drive or Dropbox with consistent naming.

workflows.name: Contract Data Extraction
workflows.description: Key terms, dates, and values are pulled from contracts with OCR and AI, then fed into your tracker.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.headline: Know your numbers in real time
items.problem: Your data is scattered across a dozen tools and no one has the full picture. Every report means exporting CSVs, pasting into spreadsheets, and hoping the numbers are still current by the time anyone reads them.
items.solution: Live data flows from every tool into one source of truth, with dashboards and scheduled reports that are always current. Decisions get made on real numbers, not last week's export.

workflows.name: Automated Weekly Report
workflows.description: Every Monday, metrics from your CRM, billing, and project tools land in your inbox as a formatted report.

workflows.name: KPI Threshold Alerts
workflows.description: A metric crosses a line — revenue dips, churn spikes, pipeline slows — and the right people hear about it instantly.

workflows.name: Cross-System Data Sync
workflows.description: Data from every tool syncs to one Sheet or database on a schedule, deduplicated and cleaned.

items.title: Internal Ops & Productivity
items.headline: Nothing falls through the cracks
items.problem: Projects start without clear ownership, updates get buried across a dozen tools, and onboarding a hire or client means a checklist someone always forgets a step on.
items.solution: The operational busywork — handoffs, alerts, provisioning, onboarding — runs itself in the background. Work moves between people and stages without anyone dropping the ball.

workflows.name: Project Kickoff Automation
workflows.description: A new project spins up tasks, deadlines, and checklists, assigned to the right people automatically.

workflows.name: Smart Notification Routing
workflows.description: Priority submissions, payments, or tickets ping the right team member via Slack, email, or SMS.

workflows.name: Employee Onboarding Workflow
workflows.description: New hires are provisioned with accounts, added to channels, and assigned training — no checklist required.

items.title: Inventory & Supply Chain
items.headline: Never get caught short on stock
items.problem: Your inventory counts are out of date the moment you save the spreadsheet. You learn about stockouts from frustrated customers, and purchase orders live in email threads no one can track.
items.solution: Stock levels stay synced across every channel in real time, reorder alerts fire before you run out, and every purchase order is visible from request to delivery. No more guessing what's on the shelf.

workflows.name: Low-Stock Alert & Reorder
workflows.description: Stock dips below a threshold, your team is alerted, and a draft purchase order is ready for review.

workflows.name: Multi-Channel Inventory Sync
workflows.description: Stock levels stay synced across your store, POS, and warehouse in near real-time to prevent overselling.

workflows.name: PO Status Tracking
workflows.description: Vendor updates are captured automatically and reflected in your tracker with live delivery ETAs.
